request.question: How many extra copies does a Book of the Month pick add? One number.

reply: The terminal has no field that marks a Book of the Month pick, so I can't give you that number. I can show revenue, units, orders or average order value, by month or quarter, broken down by genre, format, publisher, weekday, discount or title.
